# Web App & Frontend Engineering for Google Apps Script

## Purpose

Build Google Apps Script HtmlService/browser frontends with google.script.run, Promise wrappers, loading/error states, client routing/state, forms/file upload, pagination, framework bundling, responsive UI, and secure client/server boundaries. Use for GAS web UI implementation rather than general product design.
